0022600150.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, who are 5-0 and first in the Southwest, host the 0-5 Sacramento Kings, who sit 15th in the West, in Memphis's sixth game of the season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Memphis leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-112 win in Sacramento on October 25, and it also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
